motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. Use overflow-hidden on text lines and animate y from '100%' to '0%' with easing: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle y-axis parallax on the hero image and portfolio thumbnails.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards should scale down slightly (scale: 0.98) on click. Hovering cards should subtly illuminate the border to rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5).

header.layout: Fixed top, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px bottom border border-white/10.
header.content: Typographic logo 'MATRIEL STUDIO' in Clash Display. 3-4 nav links, primary CTA 'Orçamento'.

hero.layout: Min-height 100vh, flex column, center aligned content but heavily left-aligned text within a wide container. Huge negative space.
hero.content: H1: 'Transformamos negócios locais em marcas' + italic accent 'digitais' in Cormorant Garamond. Subtitle about Matriel Studio. Primary Gold CTA 'Solicitar orçamento', Secondary Outline CTA 'Ver nossos serviços'.
hero.visuals: Floating 3D-like laptop/smartphone mockup, slightly tilted, moving with gentle scroll parallax.

marquee.layout: Full width, overflowing, no vertical padding, border top/bottom.
marquee.content: Text 'SUA EMPRESA MERECE UMA PRESENÇA DIGITAL PROFISSIONAL' moving infinitely.
marquee.style: Massive text (text-8xl), outline only (text-transparent, stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)). Use framer-motion or react-fast-marquee.

sobre.layout: 12-col grid. 4 cols for sticky 'Sobre Nós' label, 8 cols for large manifesto narrative.
sobre.content: Story of Matriel Studio. Highlighting values: Profissionalismo, Criatividade, Resultado, Proximidade.

servicos.content: 4 Services: Criação de Sites, Sites para Lojas e Mercados, Landing Pages, Manutenção.
servicos.style: Cards must be dark surface, sharp or max 8px radius, subtle 1px border. Iconography should be elegant and minimal.

como_funciona.layout: Vertical list with massive numbers acting as structural anchors.
como_funciona.style: Numbers in Cormorant Garamond, very large, colored in subtle gold or white/10. Minimalist descriptions.

beneficios.content: Title: 'Por que sua empresa precisa de um site?'. Focus on local business conversion.

portfolio.layout: Offset grid or horizontal scrolling section.
portfolio.content: 4 Projects: Supermercado, Loja de Roupas, Restaurante, Empresa de Serviços.
portfolio.style: Real product photography treated with spotlight/clipped frames. Inner border on images to make them feel like premium physical prints.

depoimentos.content: Testimonials from local merchants. Use large hanging quote marks in Gold.

contato.content: H2 'VAMOS CONVERSAR', WhatsApp Form that redirects to WhatsApp API, location Itaobim-MG.
contato.style: Button should be a massive pill or block, styled elegantly in Gold with a white WhatsApp icon.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) on most cards to separate from pure black background.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle static noise overlay (opacity 0.03) over the entire app via a fixed pointer-events-none div to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal use of shadows since it's dark mode. Rely on border contrast and background lightness variations.

hero_mockup.description: Minimalist laptop mockup in dark setting for Hero parallax

portfolio_supermercado.description: Modern grocery store aisle for supermarket portfolio

portfolio_restaurante.description: Modern luxury restaurant interior for portfolio

portfolio_loja.description: Minimalist clothing boutique interior for portfolio

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use generic AI aesthetics (vibrant purple/blue gradients, centered floating blobs, default Inter/Roboto fonts for headings).
Execute an Awwwards-level 'Editorial Dark' theme: high contrast, sharp or slightly rounded corners (max 8px), large elegant typography, and massive negative space.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automated testing.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to allow deep customization, avoiding Shadcn layout wrappers unless necessary for complex interactivity.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout file.
Use framer-motion for the kinetic hero load (line-by-line reveal) and scroll-triggered animations.
Include a static noise/grain texture overlaid globally with pointer-events-none.
Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA or APCA standards.
All copy MUST be in Portuguese BR as requested.
All components should be in .js/.jsx (no TypeScript per user environment).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text opacity is never below 60% on dark backgrounds to maintain readability.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for the marquee and abstract visual elements.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rectangles. Primary: background Gold, text Black, font-bold, tracking-wide. Hover: subtle scale down and brightness increase.
component_instructions.marquee: Use framer-motion to create the infinite scroll text. Must be slow-moving.
component_instructions.portfolio_cards: Wrap images in a container with overflow-hidden, apply scale transform on image hover, and apply a subtle inner shadow to the container.
